PRIVACY.TITLE: Privacy policy
PRIVACY.INTRO: Transcendence is a student project from 42 school. This page explains what data we collect when you use the site, why, and what you can do about it.

SECTIONS.title: Data we collect
items: Your account: username, email address, first name, last name, bio, preferred language and profile picture.
Your password, stored only in hashed form: nobody can read it, not even the team.
Your social activity: your friends, friend requests, the conversations you are part of, your messages and the files you send in them.
Your online status and the time you were last seen, visible to other users.
Your notifications (friend requests, new messages).
If you enable two-factor authentication (2FA): a secret key, stored encrypted.
If you create API keys: a name and a fingerprint of the key (never the key itself).

SECTIONS.title: Signing in with 42, Google or GitHub
items: If you sign in with one of these services, we only receive what is needed to create your account: identifier, username and email address.
We never have access to your password on these services.

SECTIONS.title: Why we use this data
items: To run the site: sign-in, profile, friends, live chat, file sharing and notifications.
To protect accounts: two-factor authentication, request rate limiting, web application firewall.
To keep a record of sensitive actions (sign-in, message deletion, bans…) in a technical log, with your username and IP address, in order to detect abuse.
We do not sell, rent or share any data, and there is no advertising.

SECTIONS.title: Who can see what
items: Your username, profile picture, bio and online status are visible to other signed-in users.
Messages and files in a conversation are only visible to the members of that conversation.
Links to chat files are personal and expire after one hour; someone removed or banned from a conversation loses access to its files.
Site administrators can view and delete accounts for moderation purposes.

SECTIONS.title: Cookies and browser storage
items: We use no advertising cookies and no tracking tools.
Your preferred language is saved in your browser so it applies on your next visit.
Your sign-in tokens are kept in memory during your visit and cleared when you sign out.

SECTIONS.title: How long we keep data
items: Your data is kept for as long as your account exists.
When you replace your profile picture, the old one is deleted from the server.
When a message is deleted, its files are also erased from the server.
When an account is deleted, its messages, files, friends and notifications are deleted too.

SECTIONS.title: Security
items: All connections to the site are encrypted (HTTPS).
Server secrets are stored in a dedicated vault (HashiCorp Vault).
Passwords are hashed and two-factor authentication keys are encrypted.

SECTIONS.title: Your rights
items: Under the GDPR, you can ask to access, correct or delete your data.
You can edit your profile and delete your profile picture or your messages directly on the site.
For any other request, such as deleting your account, contact the project team on github.com/Lasauce6/42-Transcendence.

TERMS.TITLE: Terms of service
TERMS.INTRO: By creating an account or using Transcendence, you agree to the rules below. They keep the site pleasant and safe for everyone.

SECTIONS.title: The service
items: Transcendence is a social network built as a student project at 42 school: profiles, friends, live conversations and file sharing.
The site is provided as is, with no guarantee of permanent availability. It may be changed, interrupted or reset, especially during its development.

SECTIONS.title: Your account
items: You are responsible for your account and what happens on it. Keep your password secret and enable two-factor authentication if you can.
Your profile information must be accurate and must not impersonate anyone else.
An account is personal: do not share it.

SECTIONS.title: Rules of conduct
items: No harassment, insults, threats or discriminatory remarks.
No illegal, violent or sexual content, and nothing that infringes the rights of others.
No spam, and no attempt to bypass the site's security or to access other people's data.

SECTIONS.title: Messages and files
items: You keep ownership of what you post, and you are responsible for its content.
Accepted files: images (jpg, png, gif, webp), PDF, text, Word and Excel documents, up to 10 MB per file.
Only send files you have the right to share.

SECTIONS.title: Moderation
items: Administrators and moderators can delete messages that break these rules.
Conversation administrators can remove or ban members.
In case of serious or repeated abuse, an account can be suspended or deleted.

SECTIONS.title: Public API
items: The API can be used with a personal API key, which you must keep secret.
The number of requests is limited to protect the service. Abusive use may lead to the key being revoked.

SECTIONS.title: Personal data
items: How your data is used is described in our privacy policy.

SECTIONS.title: Changes and contact
items: These terms may change; the update date at the top of the page shows the latest version.
For any question, contact the project team on github.com/Lasauce6/42-Transcendence.
